==Fate of the Gholam==
- The Gholam is Shadowspawn.

- We know for a fact Shadowspawn cannot use gateways and they die when they enter one (cfr. Deathgates)

So instead of endlessy falling in the void used for Skimming, should he not have died/been destoyed the second he entered the gateway?

[[User:Jell Gordan|Jell Gordan]] ([[User talk:Jell Gordan|talk]]) 19:53, November 5, 2012 (UTC)

In [[A Memory of Light/Chapter 1]], Rand says that the ''gholam'' is the only type of Shadowspawn that they made that could go through a gateway. However, in a ''Towers of Midnight'' signing, Brandon Sanderson stated that ''gholam'' weren't Shadowspawn. He may have "corrected" that statement with what's in ''AMoL''. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 00:33, November 6, 2012 (UTC)

== Why was the gholam ordered to avoid notice? ==

It is mentioned twice in the novels, the first time by the gholam itself, that he has been ordered to avoid notice (except by his victims). What could be the reason? The gholam is nearly indestructible, so it would hardly matter if he murders his victims in public or unnoticed. [[Special:Contributions/79.178.125.209|79.178.125.209]] 13:56, April 8, 2018 (UTC)
